Projects

A selection of academic and hands-on projects.

Hotel Booking Website — Aurelia Grand

A hotel booking website built for a fictional luxury hotel brand, “Aurelia Grand.” Includes a home page with a hero section, a rooms showcase, a booking flow, and a receipt page, styled with a dark, elegant theme and gradient accents.

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • Responsive Design
Live Demo GitHub

Automatic Car Parking System

An embedded-systems project that indicates and manages parking slot availability in real time using ultrasonic sensors, LEDs, a display, and a buzzer, driven by a microcontroller. Built to explore the basics of sensor input, embedded logic, and hardware-software interaction.

  • Arduino / ESP8266
  • Ultrasonic Sensor
  • LEDs
  • Display
  • Buzzer
  • Embedded C/C++
GitHub

Titanic Survival Prediction — ML Model

A machine learning model built on the classic Titanic dataset to predict whether a passenger survived. Work included data preprocessing, feature scaling, handling missing values, filling null values, and encoding categorical features into numerical form ahead of model training and deployment.

  • Python
  • Pandas
  • NumPy
  • Scikit-learn
